description:
Every active site in this workspace with its site_id, domain, brand, tracked competitor domains, latest citation audit, WordPress pairing and Google connections.

Billing: free — a read-only lookup; works at a zero balance.

When to call: first, for the site_id values (every site-scoped tool takes site_id or domain) and each site's competitor_domains (pass only those as competitor_domain); also when the user asks which sites or competitors are tracked. Pass latest_audit.audit_id to get_audit (free) to see where competitors are cited instead.

Returns { sites: [{ site_id, domain, brand, name, competitor_domains, created_at, latest_audit: { audit_id, completed_at, prompt_count, engines, citation_rate (0–1), report_url } | null, wordpress: { wp_site_id, status } | null, google: { search_console, analytics, reconnect_required?, connect_url? }, briefing | null, competitor_hints? }], next_step?, suggested_next? }. latest_audit includes check_brand_citation / get_share_of_voice runs on the domain; report_url is public: give it to the user. wp_site_id is what the wp_* tools take. google false: give connect_url (a one-time Google sign-in) before query_search_console / query_google_analytics; reconnect_required: true means the Google sign-in stopped working, so nothing can be read until the user reconnects at connect_url. competitor_hints: tracked competitors no answer cited in 60 days (maybe a wrong domain): raise them, never applied. Empty list: ask for the domain and call add_site.
name: list_sites
title: List the workspace's sites, site_ids and competitor domains
